definitions.short: a gown (as if hammered out wide)
definitions.full: H6361. petash [ מְּטַשׁ ] noun [masculine] a garment , meaning dubious, tunic (Thes) or leggings SAC JPhil. xxvi (1899), 309 ; (probably later insertion in text Id. ib. 311 ff. ) (Talmud (rare); √ פטשׁ spread out according to K § 57 b ) a )); — plural suffix הון פטישי Kt (probably ׳מְּטִי K §§ 54, 3 a ) a ); 57, b ) a ), Kmp on the passage M 78* and others ׳מַּטִּי ), מַּטְּשֵׁיהוֺן Qr, Dan 3:21 ; conjectures on meaning see in Behrm Bev Dr M 78 *.
